name: TradeX
long_description:
TradeX is a prediction market platform for people to bet on their every day events like no of ebola cases, winner of super bowl, rainfall in nyc or the next president. 

5+ users combined did more than $300m in annual trading volume. Founded by 3 engineers and repeat founders from IIT Delhi and Roorkee, one of the most prestigious college in India. 

We run direct to consumer prediction market exchange as well provide broker APIs for casinos, stock broking apps to integrate out exchange and facilitate events trading inside their platforms.
one_liner: Prediction Market exchange for Asian market
